title: Shabbir ka matam karna hai
body:
shabbir ka matam karna hai
mazloom ka matam karna hai
zehra ki duae'n lena hai
ham paida huwe hain is gham ko
<<DIVIDER>>
ye gham jo hai dil ki dhadkan
is gham ki khatir jeena hai
is gham ki khatir marna hai
shano'n ko sheh par karke fida
<<DIVIDER>>
dariya ke kanaare maara gaya
abbas ka matam karna hai
mashkeeze ka matam karna hai
jo apni jaan ko khota raha
<<DIVIDER>>
chalees baras jo rota raha
sajjad ka matam karna hai
zanjeer ka matam karna hai
atthara baras wala dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki jaa'n laila ka jigar
barchi se ran me maragaya
akber ka pursa dena hai
asgher ke gale par teer laga
<<DIVIDER>>
tar khoon huwa nanha sa gala
masoom ka matam karna hai
har qalb ko jhula banna hai
zehra ka karam hai sab dawar
<<DIVIDER>>
izzat bhi mili hai matam se
saqqa e haram ke parcham ko
ab thame huwe hi chalna hai
